issue.title: 80x24 user-question modal leaves the question text box with no visible content row
issue.description:
Proposed by phase sase-1vd.4 (pane-cues, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1) of epic sase-1vd; filed by the sase-1vd land agent.

At 80x24 the user-question response modal's question text box (`#user-question-text-scroll`) shows a bordered box with no visible content row. Users on a small terminal cannot read the question or the sase-1vd copy cues inside it (prose underlines and the "also copyable" block). The border subtitle `3/8 copied · y` still renders. Phase sase-1vd.4 saw the same empty box on the pre-change code path, so the epic did not cause it. The committed golden `tests/ace/tui/visual/snapshots/png/question_pane_cues_light_80x24.png` (and `question_copy_panel_light_80x24.png` underneath the panel) records the empty box.

Root cause (land agent's analysis): `src/sase/ace/tui/styles.tcss` declares `#user-question-text-scroll { height: auto; max-height: 40%; border: solid $secondary; padding: 1 2; }`, unchanged since 2026-02-19 (c1f6251bfc2). At 80x24 the 40% cap leaves the box about 3 rows tall. The border takes 2 rows and the vertical padding takes the rest, so no content row remains. At 120x40 the same rules leave about 5 content rows.

Suggested direction: guarantee at least 1-2 content rows (for example, drop vertical padding in the narrow layout, or set a min-height that fits border, padding, and content), then re-capture the 80x24 question goldens with `just fix-tui-screenshots` after reading tui_screenshot.md. Do not change the 120x40 layout.

task_type_fields.impact: Users on 80x24 terminals cannot read the question they are answering or see the sase-1vd copy cues without enlarging the terminal.
task_type_fields.repro: Open the user-question modal at 80x24 (or view tests/ace/tui/visual/snapshots/png/question_pane_cues_light_80x24.png): the bordered question box between the header and the options shows no question text.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1vd.4 proposed it as a follow-up. On small terminals users cannot read the question text or the new copy cues, and the committed 80x24 goldens record an empty box.
